visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a first-person POV inside a dark, Victorian-style hallway. The character is holding a small cake on a wooden tray. In the bottom right corner, a female streamer with long black hair in a white hoodie reacts excitedly. The character drops the cake, and a 'You Are Dead' screen appears. (2) After a quick cut, the character is back in the hallway, moving forward. Sudden visual glitches occur, followed by a jump scare featuring a creature with a large flower for a head. The streamer gasps and shields her eyes. (3) The character navigates through various rooms, pressing buttons on the wall while avoiding a giant hand that slams down from the ceiling. The lighting is dim with warm artificial lamps casting long shadows. (4) The character encounters a strange green creature in a metallic corridor. The scene cuts to a title screen titled 'Don't Drop The Cake' with menu options, while the streamer smiles and summarizes her experience.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with high-pitched, excited female commentary. Tension-building ambient strings play in the background. A sharp, percussive thud occurs as the character in game drops the cake. (2) A new phase begins as the vocal intensity spikes into a sharp scream during a jump scare. High-frequency digital glitches are heard. Fast-paced percussive footsteps sync with the character's movement. (3) Mechanical clicks and door latch sounds punctuate the continuous narration. The BGM maintains a low-frequency drone with occasional synth risers as the character navigates rooms. (4) A heavy, distorted impact sound (the giant hand) triggers a momentary volume swell in the cinematic BGM. The speaker maintains a high speech rate with very few pauses. (5) The audio concludes with a descending stinger effect. The BGM fades out into studio silence as the final humorous remark is made.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience with comedic reactions to horror gameplay highlights. The video showcases the streamer's personality and the unique 'cake-balancing' mechanic of the game.
